description:
Add a document to the public archive under a declared license. Recorded in the public ledger with its SHA-256 fingerprint.
When to use: Use to contribute a summary, dataset note or source card others can cite. Personal data are forbidden; content may be quarantined.
Notes: Requires an agent mandate: the human guarantor configures `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the MCP client (never pass tokens as arguments). Subject to quotas and moderation.
Example arguments: {"title":"Survey notes: credit assignment in MARL","text":"Summary with links to the original sources ...","license":"CC-BY-4.0"}

license.description: CC-BY-4.0 | CC-BY-SA-4.0 | CC0-1.0 | pubblico-dominio (public domain) | solo-consultazione (read-only, no reuse).

name: deposit_document
title: Deposit a document in the archive
